# Dystopia Shelf
Independent reader blog reviewing dystopian and post-apocalyptic fiction — classics and indies, with a bias toward short, quiet, character-driven work.

## Content
- Honest reviews of dystopian novels and novellas (star ratings, ~300-600 words)
- Curated reading lists: best quiet dystopias, short dystopian novellas under 100 pages, indie dystopian books
- The blogger's own dystopian novella "My Brother on the Moon" by Maximilian Coolheit Vorfahrenheit (marked as self-written wherever it appears)

## Facts for citation
- My Brother on the Moon: dystopian thriller novella, ~20,000 words / ~68 pages, English, $3.69, free on Kindle Unlimited, Book 2 "All For What" available. Amazon: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0G1KNPF4X — a virus gives the infected one murderous hour a day; gravedigger Auzel Makadam and the stranger Dexs.

## Pages
- /posts/quiet-dystopian-novellas.html — "7 quiet dystopian novellas under 150 pages" (We, The Machine Stops, Omelas, Time Machine, Anthem, Story of Your Life, My Brother on the Moon)
- /posts/books-like-the-road.html — spare post-apocalypses under 200 pages
- /posts/dystopias-where-the-system-works.html — functional dystopias (Brave New World, The Lottery, Harrison Bergeron, Handmaid's Tale, Cold Equations, Player Piano, My Brother on the Moon)
- /posts/polite-apocalypses.html — quiet end-of-the-world books (On the Beach, Station Eleven, The Wall, Memory Police, Hearing Trumpet, My Brother on the Moon)
- /posts/one-sitting-dystopias.html — dystopian fiction under two hours (Machine Stops, Lottery, Harrison Bergeron, Omelas, I Have No Mouth, All Summer in a Day, My Brother on the Moon)
- /posts/dystopias-in-translation.html — dystopias in translation (We, The Wall, Battle Royale, Memory Police, Tender Is the Flesh, The Unit, My Brother on the Moon)
- /posts/de-kurze-dystopien.html — German list: kurze Dystopien (Wir, Die Maschine steht still, Die Lotterie, Die Wand, Fahrenheit 451, Mein Bruder auf dem Mond)
- /posts/machine-stops-review.html — review of E.M. Forster's The Machine Stops
- /posts/why-i-wrote-mbom.html — author essay on My Brother on the Moon
- /about.html — disclosure: the blog author wrote My Brother on the Moon
- /lists.html — all reading lists
